mission: Deliver one validated NexusCentral application from one source tree, with desktop and web runtime profiles, local-owned user state, routing-only shared model capacity, internal application APIs, and evidence-gated harness execution.
objective: Compare exact trees and unique patches.

acceptedEvidence.claim: Local and live remote branch topology is recorded without mutating refs.
The 133-path source snapshot separates durable candidates from preserved private, generated, and transient paths.

allowedReads: Git refs, objects, commit graphs, trees, diffs, patch IDs, and worktree status
Live remote heads via git ls-remote without fetch
Source inventory, branch inventory, and classification packets
Hashes and bounded metadata for durable candidates and later control artifacts
exclusions: No fetch, checkout, switch, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset, clean, stash, add, commit, push, or ref update
No source, index, branch, remote, worktree, or user-owned artifact mutation
No transfer, sanitation, publication, or integration decision
No raw private content copied into evidence
acceptanceGate: Unique commits and exact tree differences are separately identified.
oneFixPlan: Separate commit topology, tree identity, patch equivalence, tracked dirty changes, durable untracked candidates, and late control artifacts in one read-only report.
validationCommand: Re-read live remote heads and Git objects; independently verify commit sets, tree hashes, patch IDs, changed paths, candidate hashes, exclusions, and zero mutation.
cancellationRule: Stop before any command that writes refs, the index, a worktree, remotes, or source content.
